body:
## Pull request overview

This pull request implements Phase B (Element Library & Builder) and Phase C (Sharing, Embedding & Permissions) of the Airtable Interface gap analysis roadmap.

**Changes:**
- Phase B adds interactive elements (button, filter, form, record_picker), blank page free-form canvas layout with grid positioning, variable binding for record picker, and Studio Interface Builder configuration
- Phase C introduces sharing and embedding schemas with public link, password protection, domain restrictions, expiration, and iframe embedding controls for interfaces and forms

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/ui/sharing.zod.ts | New sharing & embedding protocol schemas (SharingConfigSchema, EmbedConfigSchema) |
| packages/spec/src/ui/sharing.test.ts | Comprehensive test coverage for sharing configurations (114 lines, 2 test suites) |
| packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts | Added sharing field to FormViewSchema for public form sharing |
| packages/spec/src/ui/view.test.ts | Tests for FormViewSchema sharing integration (44 lines) |
| packages/spec/src/ui/interface.zod.ts | Added sharing and embed fields to InterfaceSchema |
| packages/spec/src/ui/interface.test.ts | Extensive tests for interactive elements, blank layout, variables, and sharing (394 lines, 8 test suites) |
| packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts | Added interactive element types, PageVariableSchema enhancements (record_id type, source field), BlankPageLayoutSchema for free-form canvas |
| packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts | Added prop schemas for 4 interactive elements (button, filter, form, record_picker) and ComponentPropsMap registration |
| packages/spec/src/ui/index.ts | Export sharing.zod module |
| packages/spec/src/studio/interface-builder.zod.ts | New Studio Interface Builder configuration schemas (snap, zoom, palette, panels) |
| packages/spec/src/studio/interface-builder.test.ts | Test coverage for Interface Builder schemas (118 lines, 4 test suites) |
| packages/spec/src/studio/index.ts | Export Interface Builder schemas and types |
</details>

The expiresAt field should use .datetime() validation to ensure proper ISO 8601 format validation. The codebase consistently uses z.string().datetime() for ISO 8601 datetime fields across all other schemas (e.g., identity.zod.ts, audit.zod.ts, conversation.zod.ts). This provides runtime validation that the string is a valid ISO 8601 datetime, preventing invalid values like '2027-13-45' from being accepted.

Change:
expiresAt: z.string().optional()

To:
expiresAt: z.string().datetime().optional()
```suggestion
  expiresAt: z.string().datetime().optional()
```

The publicLink field should use .url() validation to ensure it's a valid URL. The codebase consistently uses z.string().url() for URL fields across all other schemas (e.g., webhook.zod.ts line 69, connector/saas.zod.ts line 80, documentation.zod.ts line 51). This provides runtime validation that the string is a properly formatted URL, preventing invalid values like 'not-a-url' from being accepted.

Change:
publicLink: z.string().optional()

To:
publicLink: z.string().url().optional()
```suggestion
  publicLink: z.string().url().optional().describe('Generated public share URL'),
```

The allowedOrigins array should validate that each origin is a valid URL. For security-sensitive CORS/iframe configurations, the codebase pattern is to use simple string arrays (e.g., object-storage.zod.ts line 246, plugin-security-advanced.zod.ts line 552), but given that these are iframe parent origins used for security decisions, consider adding .url() validation to each array element to prevent configuration errors.

Consider changing:
allowedOrigins: z.array(z.string()).optional()

To:
allowedOrigins: z.array(z.string().url()).optional()

This ensures origins are properly formatted URLs (e.g., 'https://example.com') rather than accepting potentially invalid values.
```suggestion
  allowedOrigins: z.array(z.string().url()).optional()
```
